# Icons

Place icon16.png, icon48.png, and icon128.png here.

You can generate them from the SVG below using any image editor or tool like Inkscape/SVGR.

```svg
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 128 128">
  <rect width="128" height="128" rx="24" fill="#7c3aed"/>
  <text x="64" y="90" font-size="80" text-anchor="middle" fill="white">⚡</text>
</svg>
```
